articleTitle: A Novel Low-Power Ternary D-Latch based on GNRFET-RRAM
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: This paper presents a low-power and energy-efficient ternary D-latch design utilizing Graphene Nanoribbon Transistors (GNRFETs) and Resistive Random-Access Memory (RRAM). Exploiting inherent multi-level capabilities of GNRFETs and the non-volatility of RRAM, we achieve a significant reduction in power consumption and improved energy efficiency compared to traditional designs. Furthermore, a comparative analysis against a CNTFET-RRAM D-latch is conducted and demonstrating substantial improvements in terms of propagation delay, power dissipation and power-delay product (PDP), respectively. Simulation results reveal that the proposed GNRFET-RRAM ternary D-latch offers significantly lower delay, power and PDP making it highly attractive for energy-constrained applications such as embedded systems and IoT devices. This work paves the way for the development of low-power, high-density ternary logic circuits based on emerging nanoscale technologies.

articleTitle: IoT based Real Time and Remote Fuel Tank and CNG Gas Tank Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: Efficient and safe monitoring of fuel and gas levels is critical in modern systems, particularly for vehicles and industrial applications. This project, titled "Fuel and Gas Level Monitoring," introduces an advanced IoT-enabled system that tracks fuel and Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) levels in real-time. By utilizing a combination of sensors—including a level sensor, pressure sensor, and gas sensor— integrated with an Arduino microcontroller, the system ensures accurate measurements and robust safety features. The primary objectives are twofold: real-time monitoring to prevent unexpected shortages and optimize refueling schedules, and enhanced safety by detecting gas leaks or abnormal pressure levels to mitigate potential hazards. Data from the sensors is displayed on an LCD for local monitoring and uploaded to the cloud via Wi-Fi for remote access and analytics. Alerts, both visual and audible, are triggered through the LCD and buzzer for immediate attention in case of critical conditions.Compared to existing systems that rely on basic fuel-level tracking and limited connectivity, this proposed solution incorporates IoT capabilities for seamless cloud integration, making it more reliable and scalable. It leverages wireless communication for real- time data accessibility, enhancing operational efficiency and safety standards. This innovative system has significant implications for ensuring safety, efficiency, and proactive maintenance in fuel and gas monitoring applications.

articleTitle: IoT-based Smart Barrier Guard System for Enhanced Safety and Traffic Management
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: This advanced IoT-based automatic barrier gate system focuses on the aspect of prioritization for emergency vehicles and enhances the traffic management systems. The proposed IoT-based system combines RFID technology in 98% detection accuracy, the application of vibration sensors in 95% collision detection, and Zigbee communication at 98% reliability. Similarly, the conditions at which it was conducted were simulated in the testing environment by managing 200 vehicles and 50 emergency scenarios which consequently went ahead to reduce their response time to emergencies down to 75% and improved the efficiency of the traffic by 70%. RFID detection accuracy was 98% at 15 meters distance, vibration sensors achieved 95% collision detection accuracy, and Zigbee ensured 98% communication reliability. The time taken by the barrier for its operation was 1.5 seconds and the power consumption was 7-10 watts. The above IoT-based solution brings wide improvement towards governing the urban traffic and safety based upon automation and real-time communication.

articleTitle: Design of Low Power High Speed Flipflop using 18nm FinFET Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: A flip-flop is a type of sequential logic circuit used primarily for storing digital data in various digital devices, thereby improving the functionality of digital circuits. The conventional flip-flops suffers from high power consumption and also have higher transistor count. This paper introduces a novel flip-flop architecture designed for energy efficiency. The proposed flip-flop demonstrates high reliability while maintaining low power consumption. The architecture was simulated employing 18 nm finFET technology with a power supply of 0.7 V. The proposed flip-flop design aims to minimise power consumption and improve operational speed. Reducing the number of PMOS transistors may enhance the efficiency of the proposed design. A single clock serves as the primary interface for the clock signal to enter the circuit. The proposed designs have been executed using 18 nm finFET chip technology. This study performs a PVT assessment to determine the reliability of the flip-flop. The proposed flip-flop exhibits a minimum power reduction of 9.22% compared to existing flip-flops, a minimum leakage power reduction of 17.48%, and a minimum clock-to-output delay reduction of 68.37%.

articleTitle: Optimized Dual-Stage Grid-Tied PV System with Level Shift PWM Control
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: This paper presents an optimized dual-stage grid-tied photovoltaic (PV) system employing an advanced Level Shift Pulse Width Modulation (LSPWM) control method to increase efficiency, power quality, and grid compliance. The suggested system combines a high-performance DC-DC boost converter with Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) and a Multilevel inverter with a cascaded H-bridge (MLI) to ensure optimal power extraction and efficient DC-AC conversion. The LSPWM approach efficiently minimizes the Total Harmonic Distortion (THD), minimizes losses in switching, and improves voltage regulation, ensuring seamless grid integration. A comprehensive analysis, including theoretical modeling, Simulation, and experimental validation, reveals that the proposed system outperforms traditional grid-tied PV inverters. The results confirm enhanced energy conversion efficiency, lower harmonics, and improved dynamic response, making the system highly suitable for modern grid-connected renewable energy applications.

articleTitle: An IoT-Enabled Whistle Counter System for Automated Monitoring and Control in the Cookers
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of an Automated Whistle Counter for Pressure Cookers with Blynk IoT integration, aimed at enhancing cooking efficiency and safety. The system employs an ESP microcontroller as the central processing unit, interfacing with a sound sensor to detect and count whistle sounds during cooking. Users can set the desired whistle count via a 4×4 keypad or remotely through the Blynk IoT app, providing flexibility and convenience. An OLED display provides real-time feedback on the whistle count and cooking status. Additionally, a servo motor and buzzer activate alerts when the target whistle count is reached, preventing overcooking or food burning. The system also supports remote monitoring and control via the IoT platform, enhancing user experience. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed solution automates cooking monitoring, improves accuracy, and integrates smart control, making it a valuable addition to modern kitchens.

articleTitle: Eco Dairy: Advanced IoT for Sustainable Dairy Management
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: EcoDairy is a system innovative that balances energy use, promotes hygiene, and facilitates waste management in dairy farms. There are great barriers to properly monitoring energy usage, adhering to hygienic norms, and efficiently regulating waste in today's dairy farms. These inabilities result in increased operating costs, environmental pollution, and contaminated milk production. Our research focuses on developing artificial-intelligence-combined, Internet-of-Things (IoT)-based systems to solve these problems. EcoDairy provides real-time data analytics and automation, making energy conservation, better sanitation management, and waste regulation easier to achieve. Applying this system improves dairy operations, reduces environmental impact, and creates a more sustainable and improved dairy ecosystem.

articleTitle: Lead Acid Battery Optimization and Fault Prediction using IoT
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: Lead-acid batteries play a crucial role in various applications, including renewable energy storage, automotive systems, and uninterruptible power supplies. However, their efficiency and lifespan are significantly affected by operational conditions and timely fault detection. This research presents an IoT-based optimization and fault prediction system for lead-acid batteries using the VL53L optical sensor. The proposed system continuously monitors critical battery parameters, including electrolyte levels and temperature, using the VL53L sensor and other auxiliary sensors. The collected data is transmitted to an IoT platform for real-time analysis, fault detection, and predictive maintenance. Machine learning algorithms are implemented to identify patterns and predict potential failures, enabling proactive maintenance and improving battery performance. The system enhances battery reliability, reduces downtime, and optimizes overall efficiency. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in extending battery life and minimizing unexpected failures. This work contributes to sustainable energy management by integrating IoT and predictive analytics for lead-acid battery monitoring.

articleTitle: Internet of Things based Automated Water Level Monitoring and Alert System
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: The proposed system for monitoring floods provides real-time information on flood threats using advanced water level and flow sensing devices. It can give you sustainable and up-to-date condition monitoring by continuously monitoring water levels and flow rates. By employing IoT technology, they can send data easily by a cloud-based platform that enhances remote access and an in-depth analysis. This feature is particularly useful for stakeholders and authorities who are required to make efficient and timely decisions for minimizing damage and risks. When the levels of the water reach a certain dangerous level, it sends trigger alerts by GSM texting automatically to the local people, emergency and authority personnel. Such anticipation enhances preparation, response, and general disaster management. Reducing manual surveillance and capitalizing on the automated data aggregation, are large enhancements to minimize delays and human errors, enabling access to the more precise flood risk determination. In addition, the patterns of the past flood events collected by the system could be analyzed to predict patterns of the future and can serve as the basis of its long-term planning and decentralized rapid response through resource mobilization. When combined with forecasting equipment, it becomes even more reliable, leading to accurate forecasts and timely response. Using modern technology, this system for monitoring floodwater represents an inexpensive, reliable, and scalable solution Keywords— Water Level and Flow Sensors, Internet of Things (IoT) Technology, GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) Alerts, Automated Data Collection, Historical Data Analysis

articleTitle: LabVIEW based Patient Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: In modern healthcare, real-time patient monitoring is essential for timely diagnosis and intervention. This paper presents the development of a Patient Monitoring System using LabVIEW, integrating multiple sensors and wireless communication for efficient data acquisition and visualization. The system utilizes Arduino-based DHT11 and MAX30100 sensors to measure temperature, humidity, heart rate, and SpO₂ (oxygen saturation) levels. The acquired physiological data is interfaced with LabVIEW to provide real-time visualization and analysis. To enable wireless transmission, Amplitude Shift Keying (ASK) modulation is applied to the sensor data, which is then transmitted and received using a Universal Software Radio Peripheral (USRP). This system enhances remote patient monitoring by ensuring real-time, reliable, and secure data transmission, making it suitable for telemedicine and IoT-based healthcare applications.

articleTitle: Efficient Real-Time Water Distribution Network using Internet of Things (IoT)
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: In both rural and urban settings, inadequate distribution systems and water scarcity present major problems. For instance, there exists a significant problem with inconsistency of water arrival time that the residents of a locality are unaware of; this inconsistency is observed due to manual monitoring by water distributors. As there is a manual monitoring system, a leak in the pipe cannot be sensed instantly which allows for a lot of wastage as water continues to flow. In this paper, we propose an Efficient Water Distribution Network (EWDN)which integrates Arduino UNO, water level sensors, relay modules, and Real-Time clocks (RTC) in order to automate the process -divide it, store the water in form of containers, detect leakage in pipelines, and provide water supply at scheduled time intervals. It notifies residents two days ahead about the expected arrival time of water through SMS, and two hours before water supply. It automatically operates the water pump to release water for a set time. In the event a leak is detected, it immediately switches off the pump and sends out an SMS alert to the water distributor and residents, reducing further water wastage. It reduces the manual effort, provides efficient water management by minimizing the wastage of water and ensures optimal delivery of the water. The experimental results show that the proposed system is effective in enhancing water management and safety by minimizing operational inefficiencies and can be used for smart city applications.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Soil Stability Assessment and Landslide Forecasting with Multi-Sensor Networks, Edge Computing, and Jetson Nano Integration
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: Landslides pose a severe threat to mountainous regions, often resulting in catastrophic damage and loss of life. Existing prediction methods rely on limited data sources and infrequent monitoring, leading to delays in early warnings. Previous technologies have explored individual sensor applications, such as Ground-Penetrating Radar (GPR) and seismic sensors, but lack a comprehensive multi-sensor approach with real-time processing. Notable cases, like the Wayanad landslides in Kerala, India, highlight the urgent need for advanced predictive systems. This study proposes an AI-driven landslide prediction system using a network of 40 sensor-equipped slave kits. Each kit integrates GPR, seismic, Electromagnetic Induction (EMI), ultrasonic, LiDAR, capacitance probes, gravimeters, Electrical Resistivity Tomography (ERT), and magnetometers onto a Teensy 4.1 microcontroller with an ESP8266 for wireless data transmission. Data is processed at a central master unit featuring a Jetson Nano module, employing the ALEXNET+BILSTM model for real-time analysis of soil stability and landslide risk. By leveraging edge computing, this system enables rapid decision-making and early warnings, addressing the limitations of existing methods. Its scalable, cost-effective architecture enhances environmental monitoring, offering a robust solution for landslide-prone communities and significantly improving disaster preparedness.

articleTitle: Detection and Quantification of Catharanthine Alkaloids in Catharanthus Roseus Leaves using Electrochemical and Optical Methods
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: Catharanthus roseus leaves contain several bioactive alkaloids, including vincristine and vinblastine, which are crucial for the development of cancer-treatment drugs. These alkaloids are derived from catharanthine. In this study, UV and electrochemical methods were used to detect and quantify catharanthine in Catharanthus roseus leaves. UV spectrometry plays a crucial role in detecting and quantifying natural alkaloids for industrial and pharmaceutical applications. Catharanthine contains a biologically important indole moiety, a heterocyclic derivative, which exhibits characteristic UV-visible (UV-Vis) absorption in the 200–300 nm range due to π-π* electronic transitions within its conjugated system. The indole ring, composed of fused benzene and pyrrole rings, facilitates extensive electron delocalization, resulting in strong π-π* transitions in the 220–300 nm range. Chloroform (CHCl₃) is used to extract catharanthine due to its high solubility. Experimental UV-Vis analysis confirmed the presence of catharanthine through characteristic absorption peaks at 246 and 291 nm, where greater spectral intensity corresponds to higher catharanthine concentrations. To accurately characterize the spectra, a UV-Vis spectrophotometer was used for direct measurement, allowing precise determination of individual leaf concentrations. Electrochemical detection of catharanthine in Catharanthus roseus leaves was also performed using cyclic voltammetry (CV). This highly sensitive method can detect very low catharanthine concentrations due to the strong interaction between the indole moiety and the glassy carbon electrode surface. The CV method generates a measurable electrical signal when a voltage is applied within the range of 0.4 to 1.0 V. The intensity of this signal is directly proportional to the catharanthine concentration in the sample. Using this approach, catharanthine concentrations in the tested samples were measured within the range of 0.005 to 0.02 mg/ml.

articleTitle: IoT-based Smart Milk Safety System for Preventing Overheating and Burn Risks
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: This study introduces an advanced Smart Milk Safety System aimed at preventing milk from overheating and burning through continuous temperature monitoring and automated control mechanisms. Utilizing an ESP8266 microcontroller alongside a DS18B20 temperature sensor, the system consistently monitors the temperature of the milk and automatically deactivates the heating element once a specified temperature limit is reached. A buzzer alerts the user when the milk is ready, thereby reducing the need for constant oversight and minimizing the risk of boil-overs or scorching. This innovative system not only enhances kitchen safety and energy efficiency by averting unattended heating incidents but also helps in reducing milk wastage. By incorporating IoT technology, the system offers a dependable, automated solution designed for contemporary households, ensuring both convenience and accuracy in daily cooking tasks. Experimental results validate the system’s capability in maintaining optimal heating control, highlighting its potential as a valuable tool for smart kitchen automation.

articleTitle: Advanced Detection of Machine Failure in Automated Industries using Long-Short Term Memory and LightGBM
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving industrial landscape, companies are using various technologies to optimize their operations which thereby reduce costs, and they focus on increasing their profits. Proactive maintenance has emerged as an important strategy that enable industries to foresee and prevent machine failures beforehand. This proactive approach not only extends the machine lifespan but also leads to cost savings. Machine failure detection is very essential in automated industries, medical fields, aerospace, transportation and many more industries where machinery is central for the production process. Traditional reactive maintenance methods only focus on repairing the machines after the occurrence of the failure which greatly affects the production. Machine learning, with it’s ability to analyze large datasets and identify the unusual patterns based on the historical data. This paper mainly proposes using a hybrid approach of the ML algorithms to increase the accuracy and efficiency of the detection of machine failures. The algorithms are Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) networks and Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM). This approach is mainly used for early fault detection in machines. We combine the features of LSTM to find temporal patterns in sensor data with LightGBM’s capacity to refine predictions and analyze feature importance. This approach accurately finds the failure predictions, then classify failure severity that can be visualized using graphs and trigger actionable maintenance alerts. By this proposed approach we achieved a result of 98% accuracy on real sensor data when compared to traditional methods, outperforming them by 7%. This research fills the gap between the traditional reactive maintenance and the current predictive maintenance.

articleTitle: Luo Converter- based BLDC Motor Driven Industrial Application
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: This article discusses the problem of effectively employing a solar photovoltaic array for a water pumping system, with an emphasis on motor control and optimal power extraction. With the permanent magnet BLDC motor powering the centrifugal water pump, the intermediate DC-DC converter is integrated as a Luo converter. The Luo converter was selected for this investigation due to its simplicity, low component count, ability to minimize output current ripples, and provision of an unbounded zone for maximum power point tracking (MPPT). When a voltage source inverter VSI operates on fundamental frequency switching, an electrically commutated BLDC motor reduces high frequency switching losses and increases system efficiency. Under typical test conditions, the SPV array is intended to supply power to the motor-pump system while optimizing converter performance. MATLAB/Simulink simulation results show the system's effectiveness and suitability for many scenarios, including startup and dynamic and steady-state behaviour.

articleTitle: Advanced Bidirectional Cell Balancing for Series-Connected Batteries using Buck-Boost Converters
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: The crucial problem of imbalance in series-connected batteries brought on by manufacturing variations in individual cells is addressed in this study. These imbalances may result in decreased usable capacity, shortened lifespan, and safety issues. A novel bidirectional cell balancing technique has been proposed to mitigate these effects. Using a switch-mode power converter, the proposed Cell Balancing Circuit effectively moves energy from larger cells to weaker ones, maintaining consistent voltage levels and State-of-Charge (SOC) for every cell. Theoretical analysis and simulation results validate the efficiency of this method, showing improved battery reliability and balancing performance.

articleTitle: Internet of Things based Automatic LPG Gas Leakage Detection and Prevention System
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: This study offers an Arduino-based LPG gas leakage detection system with an automatic shut-off regulator to offset gas leak-related accidents. The proposed system uses an MQ-2 gas sensor to sense leaks and automatically activates a solenoid valve to close gas flow. According to experimental findings, the system has a rapid response time of 3 seconds and a detection rate of 95% in controlled environments, largely mitigating fire hazard risk. Moreover, an IoT-based warning system offers real-time warnings, enhancing user consciousness and responsiveness. The research identifies a cost-effective and reliable solution to maximize gas safety in domestic and industrial application. This system will activate an effective alarm immediately it detects leakage in the gas and provides critical early warnings to occupants. In addition, it automatically shuts off the main gas supply, thus preventing possible production of more hazards. A system like this is well needed because detecting LPG leaks that are flammable is often very challenging, which can easily lead to the damage of property or physical harm to individuals. Besides, leaks, especially those that go unreported, and improper covering of hoses and regulators point out the importance of automating safety solutions.

articleTitle: Thermal and Electrical Performance of LiFePO4 Batteries under Standard Charging Conditions
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: LiFePO4 (LFP) batteries are widely used in electric vehicles (EVs) due to their superior thermal stability, long cycle life, and high safety. However, their thermal and electrical performance under standard charging conditions significantly impacts overall efficiency, reliability, and longevity. This study investigates the thermal behavior and electrical characteristics of LFP batteries during charging, focusing on temperature variations, internal resistance changes, and energy efficiency. The research examines the impact of different charging methods, particularly the widely adopted Constant Current-Constant Voltage (CC-CV) technique, on heat generation and electrical losses. Key performance indicators such as voltage stability, charge acceptance, and internal resistance fluctuations are analyzed to assess their role in battery health and operational efficiency. Furthermore, thermal management approaches, including passive cooling, active cooling, and phase change materials (PCMs), are reviewed to address the challenges of heat dissipation. The findings provide insights into optimizing battery performance and longevity through improved charging strategies and advanced thermal management systems. Understanding these factors is crucial for enhancing the energy efficiency and reliability of EV battery systems. Future research should focus on integrating adaptive charging algorithms and intelligent thermal control systems to further improve battery safety and performance.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of CMOS Inverter using Gallium Nitride (GaN)
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: This article presents a numerical simulation of CMOS inverter using Gallium Nitride (GaN) technology and utilizes Atlas TCAD for composition modeling and electrical characterization. Simulation focuses on GaN/AlGaN heterocercal, adaptation of physical properties for high electron mobility and improves switching performance. The device is designed with doping concentrations and transport models defined to achieve accurate ID VG and ID VD properties. Compared to traditional silicone-based inverters, GaN-based reformers show better effect efficiency, high degradation voltage and increased thermal stability, making them ideal for high frequency and high-power applications. The simulation results obtained validate the possibility of GAN CMOS inverter with better performance measurements. The structure confirms the expected behavior by demonstrating possible rf and power electronics. This study highlights the benefits of GAN technology in the next generation semiconductor units and promotes further progress in high executive digital and analog cycles.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Powered Home Automation using Node MCU
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: This research work proposes an IoT-based home automation system with the NodeMCU ESP8266 module as the controller. The system allows users to remotely monitor and control home appliances via a mobile app or web interface by taking advantage of the intrinsic Wi-Fi features of the NodeMCU. Relay modules are employed to connect and drive different appliances, enabling real-time control, monitoring, and automation. The system improves home convenience, saves energy by minimizing unnecessary power consumption, and provides valuable advantages for elderly people or those with mobility limitations. Cost-effective, easy to use, and expandable, the system shows excellent potential for further growth and realistic implementation in smart home environment.

articleTitle: Real-Time Welding Defect Detection with YOLOv8 on Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: Welding plays a vital role in industries such as manufacturing, automotive, and construction, where ensuring the strength and reliability of welded joints is essential for structural stability and safety. Defects like cracks, porosity, and incomplete fusion can weaken joints, increasing the risk of failures, raising costs, and posing safety concerns. Traditional inspection techniques, such as manual visual checks and nondestructive testing, often require significant time, financial investment, and skilled personnel, making them inefficient and prone to human error. This research introduces a real-time, cost-effective approach to welding defect detection by leveraging YOLOv8 and Raspberry Pi. The system is designed to capture high-resolution images of welds, analyze them using a deep learning model trained on a labeled dataset, and accurately classify defects Compared to traditional methods, this solution enhances defect detection efficiency while remaining affordable, particularly for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) that may not have access to high-end quality control equipment. By integrating this automated system into industrial processes, companies can improve welding quality, reduce rework costs, and enhance workplace safety, ultimately contributing to more reliable and cost-efficient manufacturing practices.

articleTitle: An Optimized Technique for Feature Extraction and EEG Signal Processing using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCI), cognitive research, and medical diagnosis all make extensive use of electroencephalography (EEG) to analyze brain activity. However, issues with EEG signal processing include limited classification accuracy, ineffective feature extraction, and noise interference. With an emphasis on enhanced feature extraction and classification, this study uses MATLAB to optimize EEG signal processing. Enhanced preprocessing methods, Independent Component Analysis (ICA) for artifact removal, and Butterworth and Chebyshev filters for noise reduction are all part of the optimization process. Time-domain, frequency-domain, and time-frequency representations like Wavelet Transform and Power Spectral Density (PSD) are used to enhance feature extraction. Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) are used for classification, which increases accuracy. Cross-validation and statistical analysis are used to verify the precision and accuracy of the results. A comparative analysis reveals advancements over current practices. In addition to discussing improvements in preprocessing clarity, the paper presents methods to improve cross-correlation (CC) and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Future research will integrate deep learning with real-time EEG streaming.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Enhanced Performance and Safety in Autonomous Vehicle Design
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: The automobile industry has changed through the application of Machine Learning (ML) techniques in the design of autonomous vehicles. Yet, ensuring enhanced performance along with safety is still a prime challenge. The focus of this paper is on solving the concrete problem of improving autonomous vehicle choices by applying machine learning algorithms to process the real-time data generated, enabling predictive maintenance strategies and adaptive safety mechanisms. The study reviews various ML-driven use cases ranging from driving automation to collision avoidance to adaptive cruise control, highlighting how they accomplish increased vehicle efficiency and accident reduction. The final research analysis demonstrate that ML based predictive modeling effectively enhances the fuel efficiency and dynamic vehicle control performance, therefore further improving autonomous vehicle operational reliability and safety.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Wideband Metamaterial based Antenna using SRR and CSRR Structures for Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: The proposed design, simulation, and analysis of small-scale metamaterial-based antennas fed by a variety of non-coplanar waveguides for diverse wireless applications, this paper at its crux seeks to strengthen. It incorporates two types of resonant devices: circular split-ring resonators (SRR) and hexagonal closed-ring resonators (CRR), in the design so as to enhance the bandwidth of the antenna while minimizing its physical dimension. This wideband wireless standard encompasses WiMAX (3.3-3.5 GHz), WLAN (5.2 GHz), IoT and 5G sub-6 GHz, RFID, and biomedical applications; operating with accuracy and efficiency between 3.06 and 5.89 GHz. Other important parameters that are either low for volume (15 mm×18 mm×1.5 mm) or some really constrained physical 0.74 kind of ka, thus making it suitable for ergonomically challenging space-constrained devices. The small size of metamaterial-oriented resonators favors bandwidths while the irregular CPW-fed configurations with above 80 percent radiation efficiency-spanning the operating frequency of antenna gain peaking at 3.65 dBi at 5.2 GHz and 65 percent impedance bandwidth. The coinciding measured and simulated results strengthen the status of the antenna vis-a-vis stability and performance. With its low-profile design, wide frequency coverage, and excellent radiation characteristics, this is a great candidate for next-generation wireless systems. Additionally, it is suitable for being fully scalable for successful integration into modern small-sized high-performance communication devices thereby simplifying the fabrication process.

articleTitle: Smart Health Care using Artificial Intelligence-Powered Electronics and Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: In the age of digital revolution, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Internet of Things (IoT) integration has changed the face of healthcare monitoring systems. The current project offers a smart healthcare solution that utilizes AI-driven electronics and IoT for remote and real-time monitoring of heart rate, body temperature, and movement. It utilizes a NodeMCU ESP8266 microcontroller and biomedical sensors to gather data, process through light AI algorithms, and send to a cloud or mobile platform through Wi-Fi. It sends alerts in real time when it detects abnormal values, allowing for instant medical intervention. Its low cost, small size, and scalability are intended to enhance elderly and chronically ill patient care while easing healthcare infrastructure. The system suggested shows reliability, responsiveness, and the feasibility of large-scale deployment in the home or clinical environment.

articleTitle: Quadcopter with Fuzzy Logic based Self-Tuning PID Controller
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: This paper presents a fuzzy logic-based self-tuning PID controller for real-time adaptive PID parameter tuning in dynamic flight conditions. Quadcopters need adaptive and precise control for stable flight under changing conditions like wind turbulence and changing payloads. Conventional Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controllers, although common, need manual tuning and are not real-time adaptive in dynamic flight conditions. The proposed fuzzy logic adaptation mechanism provides system responsiveness with continuous control gain adjustments, achieving better stability, less overshoot, and quicker response. The system is simulated and tested under MATLAB Simulink, where simulation results confirm that the self-tuning fuzzy PID controller performs better than conventional PID controllers in terms of stability, trajectory accuracy, and disturbance rejection. Results demonstrate the efficiency of adaptive control in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) control, enabling real-time deployment in autonomous drone flights.

articleTitle: Design, Modelling and Optimization of Vibration based Energy Harvester for Battery Operated Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: As the demand for energy conservation and power optimization increases, vibration-based piezoelectric energy harvesters have emerged as an effective solution. These harvesters utilize various cantilever beam configurations, including simple, tapered, L-shaped, and U-shaped designs with proof mass, commonly found in industrial machinery. For unimorph beam structures, the ratio of non-piezoelectric to piezoelectric material is set above unity, and a linear dynamic equation is formulated to model the system’s behavior. The electromechanical coupling characteristics—stress distribution, electric field, and electric potential—are analyzed and validated through COMSOL Multiphysics simulations. Among all studied configurations, the unimorph cantilever design generates the highest power and voltage output. This makes it ideal for optimizing energy harvesters in battery-operated applications. By converting ambient vibrations into usable electrical energy, these harvesters power wireless sensor networks, IoT devices, and battery-dependent systems. Additionally, they enhance the operational efficiency and range of electric vehicles by supplying supplementary energy for onboard electronics..

articleTitle: IoT based Air Quality Monitoring and Air Purifier System
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: Air pollution is an emerging issue all over the world, affecting health and the environment. This article suggests an IoT-based air quality monitoring and air purifier system to address this issue. The system utilizes NodeMCU ESP8266 as the main controller, providing Wi-Fi connectivity for IoT integration. It supports an MQ135 sensor to detect hazardous gases like CO2, NH3, and NOx, and a DHT11 sensor to detect temperature and humidity. An I2C LCD indicates real-time air quality data, making it user-friendly. To purify air, UV LEDs are utilized for killing bacteria and viruses, while a CPU fan is utilized for air circulation. A relay module is used for controlling the UV LEDs and the fan based on air quality inputs. A 12V adapter and connectors drive the system to ensure stable usage. Information is transmitted to a cloud platform and can be monitored and analyzed remotely. The system is economical, energy-efficient, and expandable for use indoors. The system continuously monitors air quality and automatically purifies the air when pollutant concentrations exceed a threshold. Testing proved reliable sensor reading, effective air cleaning, and robust IoT connectivity. The system can be installed in homes, offices, and small industries with a full solution for air quality management. The future development is to add more sensors, power optimization, and purification process improvement for bigger spaces. This technology has the potential to significantly improve public health and indoor air quality.

articleTitle: Intelligent LPG Regulator: Leak Detection and Weight Monitoring using IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: The concept of this project focuses on a complete IoT-enabled LPG gas leakage detection system, which features automatic shut-off mechanisms for both the gas regulator and electricity, automatic window openings for ventilation, and monitoring of the gas cylinder's weight. The system uses an LPG gas sensor to detect any LPG leakage, initiating immediate safety actions to prevent potential accidents. During a gas leak, the system immediately cuts off the flow of gas and also can disconnect the electricity supply to reduce fire risks. A main feature of the system is its automatic gas regulator shut-off. The instant the leak of gas is detected, the system cuts off the gas supply automatically, thus interrupting the flow of the gas from the cylinder. This action ensures that the leak is stopped at the source, preventing further gas accumulation and significantly reducing the risk of an explosion or fire. The system can also cut off the electricity supply. Since electrical sparks are one of the leading causes of fires during gas leaks, cutting off the electricity supply ensures that no spark or short circuit will ignite the leaking gas. Another feature is that the load cell periodically monitors the weight of the gas cylinder, with low weight levels monitored through an application or web interface. By preventing unforeseen shortages, this guarantees that users can effectively manage their gas supply. When an LPG gas leak is detected, the windows automatically open for ventilation, reducing the risk of an explosion or fire due to gas accumulation.

articleTitle: Temperature Effect on Short-Term Electricity Demand Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: Short-term forecasting of electricity demand is a crucial tool for understanding the dynamic nature of demand. Energy utilities can schedule generation and other tasks like demand side control more quickly because to this expertise. A lot of things affect how much electricity is used, such as the effects of temperature, social activities, holidays, the workplace, and so on. If erroneous forecasting methods and data are used, the power system operators could be duped and undergo major adjustments. A thorough examination of how temperature affects consumption patterns on weekdays, weekends, and during various seasons is included. Using demand and temperature data from the previous day for the full year, short-term demand forecasting is done for different days of the calendar year. RNN is the model that this study suggests using to forecast demand with high accuracy and higher MAPE.

articleTitle: The Future Role of Environmental Sustainability-Optimization using Artificial Intelligence Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: The fuel consumption optimization using artificial intelligence-powered driver behavior analysis a way forward for greener roads analyzing driver behavior critically in road transport becomes essential to increasing fuel efficiency and attaining environmental sustainability. This study explores how artificial intelligence (AI) can be used to analyze and improve driver behavior in order to maximize fuel efficiency. The study shows how dynamic monitoring of driving habits and real-time feedback can result in significant fuel usage savings by utilizing AI's sophisticated learning capabilities. Artificial intelligence (AI) systems can detect inefficiencies and recommend behavioral changes to drivers by analyzing complicated data, including acceleration, braking patterns, and idle times, using advanced machine learning models. The paper examines the various obstacles that come with using AI for this purpose, such as worries about data privacy, the reliability of AI in different traffic and weather scenarios, and the human element. At the same time, it demonstrates the wide range of possibilities AI offers, including improved predictive accuracy and the potential for customized driver training programs. The study highlights the role of AI in paving the way for greener roads by discussing these opportunities and obstacles.

articleTitle: Anti Sleep Alarm for Drivers based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: Driver fatigue is a major cause of road accidents, especially in a time of rising vehicular movement and prolonged driving periods. This paper introduces the design and development of an IoT-based Anti-Sleep Alarm System to improve road safety by detecting driver drowsiness in real time and preventing it. The system employs an Arduino UNO microcontroller along with an eye blink sensor, buzzer, single-channel relay, and gear motor to track the eye activity of the driver and react pre-emptively to indicators of driver fatigue. If the system finds that the driver’s eyes stay closed for more than a specified time limit, it triggers an audible warning signal and stops the gear motor to mimic an emergency braking process. The proposed system keeps on resetting with every blink sensed, forming a feedback monitoring loop to produce prolonged driver alertness. The solution is cost-effective, non-intrusive, and extremely flexible, and thus especially suited for deployment in public transport systems, fleet management, and personal vehicles.

articleTitle: IoT-based Bus Courier Transit Through Public Transport
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: Bus Courier Transit, a system based on IoT technology, facilitates automated parcel delivery in the Tamil Nadu State Transport Corporation (TNSTC) bus fleet. The current manual system causes delays, inefficiencies, and revenue mismanagement. The solution implemented includes a customer mobile app to verify bus availability, track real-time location, and pay via digital modes. Booked parcels are then sent out from the bus station office. The system drives transparency, security, and efficiency with real-time tracking, authentication by OTP-based, and alarm by automation. The solution enables automated customer convenience, protects delivery parcels, and optimizes revenue management. The solution also supports the Naan Mudhalvan Niral Thiruvizha mission by applying GPS-based tracking to optimize route planning, real-time status, and enhanced transport efficiency. With increased public transport (SDG 11), innovation (SDG 9), and schedule optimization to reduce fuel consumption (SDG 12), the system offers a clean, safe, and secure logistics system.

articleTitle: An Efficient Technique to Implement the Multi-Valued Logic Gates using Nano-FETs
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: In this study, carbon nanotube field-effect transistors (CNTFETs) are presented as the basis for energy-efficient multiple-valued logic (MVL) circuits. Leveraging CNTFET unique properties such as electron and hole mobility, and adjustable threshold voltage via diameter control, these designs demonstrate enhanced driving capacity, noise marg ins and resilience when contrasted with earlier designs that relied on CNTFETs. The HSPICE simulations using a standard CNTFET model demonstrate that the proposed ternary and quaternary circuits significantly outperform state-of-the-art CNTFET MVL circuits. Specifically, the proposed ternary based NOT, NAND and NOR circuits show average power-delay product (PDP) reductions of 92.66%, 94.92% and 96.96%, respectively. Similarly, the quaternary NOT, NAND and NOR circuits achieve average PDP improvements of 69.43%, 52.99%, and 56.24%, respectively, compared to other existing quaternary CNTFET designs.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Resonant Converter Fed Drive for an Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: This paper presents a Reconfigurable Resonant DC-DC Bidirectional Converter designed to overcome the challenges of conventional converters in wide output voltage applications. Traditional designs often face limitations in achieving soft-switching across a broad voltage range, impacting efficiency and reliability. The proposed converter addresses this by employing topology morphing to integrate two resonant networks—CLLC and CLLC-C—enabling efficient voltage regulation over an extended range while operating within a narrow frequency band. The converter is especially well-suited for applications like energy storage systems, distributed energy systems, and electric vehicles that require high efficiency and robust performance. A 500 W laboratory prototype was created to validate the suggested topology. This improves soft-switching performance in both forward and reverse power transfer modes, increasing overall system efficiency. Experimental results confirm its effectiveness, demonstrating superior voltage regulation, efficient soft-switching, and reliable operation under varying load conditions, making it a promising solution for modern power applications.

articleTitle: Structured Buck-Boost Approach for Multi-Phase Power Conversion
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: DC-DC converter designs have come a long way due to the increasing requirement for efficient power conversion, particularly in multiphase interleaved converters. Sequential buck-boost topology, in which the buck and boost are combined to permit voltage step-down and step-up with a positive output, is investigated in this paper in terms of interleaved converters. Interleaving enhances thermal performance, reduces current ripple, and maximizes efficiency [1]. The research enlightens the nature of this topology, its application in multiphase uses, and its advantages in areas such as high-efficiency power supply, renewable energy, and electric vehicles (EVs) [2]. Implementation challenges on control systems, for instance, current regulation and phase-shifted duty cycles, are also addressed in the study [3]. Experimental results are analyzed, and real-world concepts are conceived for the use of the sequential buck-boost interleaved converter in practical applications [4].

articleTitle: Cloud-based ECG Monitoring and Analytics with IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: This project provides an ECG (Electrocardiogram) graph from the health monitoring system The graph depicts multiple waveform traces, where each line represents the electrical activities from each lead of the heart. The unique bumps and dips show the heart beating in a normal or abnormal way, and we can see the P wave, the QRS complex, and the T wave. We see a legend at the bottom of the graph — using colors to distinguish between all possible lead readings. This interface may contain buttons for configurations, exporting data, or different navigational menus indicating the interactive nature of the system and possibly for real-time heart rate monitoring. Its design is clean with a clear layout allowing medical professionals to analyze efficiently.

articleTitle: Enhancing Electric Vehicle Charging Efficiency Using Zeta Luo Converters: Design, Analysis, and Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: The increasing adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) necessitates the development of highly efficient and stable charging systems. Traditional power converters, such as buck-boost and SEPIC converters, suffer from low efficiency and poor voltage regulation, particularly under variable load conditions. This study addresses these limitations by investigating the application of Zeta Luo converters in EV charging infrastructure. The research focuses on improving power conversion efficiency and voltage stability while ensuring a compact design. A detailed design and performance analysis of the Zeta Luo converter are presented, with simulations conducted in MATLAB/Simulink to evaluate its efficiency and stability under dynamic load conditions. The results demonstrate that the Zeta Luo converter achieves an efficiency of over 92% while providing superior voltage regulation compared to conventional converters. These findings establish the Zeta Luo converter as a promising solution for modern EV charging systems and highlight its potential for further optimization and integration with renewable energy sources.

articleTitle: Enhanced Bandwidth for Slotted Patch Antenna with Defective Ground Structure
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: In a communication system, the bandwidth is one of the most important and scarce resources, extending the same is limited due to finances, supply and technology, also if the antenna or transmission lines are not perfectly matched then there will be return loss and loss of signal power. Here we demonstrate a method to enhance both the parameters viz. the return loss and bandwidth of microstrip patch antenna (MPA). To further enhance the antenna performance, defective ground structure (DGS) is used. As microstrip patch antennas have narrow bandwidth, the slots are used to enhance bandwidth. The operating frequency is chosen as 2.4 GHz ISM band for inset-fed MPA. The proposed DGS offers stop-band at 2.4 GHz. Also, the DGS can change the wave properties by providing band stop filter or band-pass filter. Its (DGS) main principle is to distribute shield current in the ground plane, which affects input impedance and hence, the current flow of antenna and as a consequence the bandwidth gets enhanced. Return loss improves with due stop bands DGS as stop-band of MPA and DGS. Among several methods to improve the return loss, we use a two rectangular shaped DGS. The position of DGS has been optimized using trial and error method. HFSS has been used for simulation and analysis. The proposed design of MPA with DGS and multiple rectangular slots has achieved better results as the bandwidth has enhanced from 58 MHz to 223MHz, also VSWR lowered from 1.7584 to 1.2236, the S11 has enhanced from -11.2154 dB to -19.951 dB, the gain also increased from 0.37478 dB to 3.5883dB. Bandwidth is enhanced and the return loss is also reduced.

articleTitle: Harnessing Energy From Non-Biodegradable Waste for a Sustainable Future using IoT
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: The project intends to create an efficient and effective problem-solver to obtain energy from non biodegradable wastes (manufactured goods made for consumption), applying newly created WTE technologies. In order to create a source of energy from waste materials and solve environmental problems regarding garbage landfills and marine litter, the initiative provides a different perspective by applying thermal treatments such as pyrolysis, gasification, and incineration. Through enhancing the energy conversion process (which from energy contributes to power measurement) and placing a quasi-maximizing performance on getting to the nearest solution (near the word, output in renewable energy, shape). This project ultimately aims to provide a real, low carbon footprint waste management solution, low environmental impact and a replicable development model for communities around the world.

articleTitle: Smart Helmet for Alcohol Detection to Avoid Accidents in Bike Riders using IoT
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)

authors.preferredName: B V V S D Kumar Chaitanya
authors.firstName: B V V S D Kumar

abstract: The "Smart Helmet for Alcohol Detection and Accident Prevention Using IoT" project provides innovative safety features to motorcyclists by integrating Internet of Things (IoT) technology with real-time monitoring and prevention features. The helmet includes a Breathalyzer sensor to monitor alcohol intake, making the motorcycle unstartable if the alcohol concentration in the rider's blood is above the legal limit. In addition, the use of accelerometers and GPS mapping allows accidents to be detected by the identification of instantaneous crashes or collisions, which automatically sends emergency messages with the location of the rider in real time. The system uses IoT-based communication to immediately alert emergency services and authorized contacts, shortening accident response times by a considerable margin. By preventing cases of drunk driving and optimizing emergency responses, the smart helmet acts as an active safety device to reduce road fatalities and enhance the overall safety of motorcycles. Development in the future can focus on improving sensor precision, integrating health monitoring features, and broadening applications to further enhance the safety of riders.

articleTitle: Smart Water Pumping Solution using Bifacial Solar Panels for Enhanced Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: Rapid advancements in water pumping technology are being seen in structures, production facilities, and in farm equipment. PV systems are becoming more and more popular in domestic as well as agriculture since they provide a wide range of uses for domestic purposes. In isolated locations where conventional power sources are unreliable or unfeasible, these systems are very helpful. One of the best applications is solar-powered water pumping, which provides water to domestic use, cattle and also to crops. The two primary materials of a solar water pump system are pumps and solar panels. Solar panels are made up of the smallest components of solar cells. Every cell has layers of unique materials that, when exposed to sunlight, produce power. When there is a source of sun, this DC power can be delivered straight to a pump; otherwise, it can be stored in batteries for future usage. The proposed system employs bifacial solar panel catches sunlight, hence power is generated. Statistical analysis proves that it is bound to be highly performance consistent at a peak power output of 249.5 W at 1000 W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> irradiance while being consistent at low light levels, which assures uninterrupted working. It is a much more efficient, economic, and environment-friendly set up of the integration of bifacial solar panels with battery storage, which retains a continuous flow of water through it and less space occupancy. All this would make for less water consumption, smooth, unbroken continuous operations, and make this system a substitute to existing system in the conventional way for domestic applications.

articleTitle: Micro-Controller based Assisting Shoe for Visually Impaired People
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: The innovative smart shoe uses advanced technology to aid the visually impaired by detecting objects, recognizing the presence of water, and sensing falls. It uses different alarm systems and vibrations to alert its users effectively. Renewable sources of energy have drawn a lot of interest due to rising worldwide demand for electricity and developing environmental concerns; the improved smart shoe is one of the possibilities for creating the best choice for the visually impaired people sustainably. The smart shoe is efficient and small design is one of its main advantages. It enables ultrasonic sensor, moisture sensor, a piezoelectric sensor, alarm, vibrant and mini TF player to give the best optimal path from unwanted areas. The generator is a flexible option for urban settings because it can be easily incorporated into the current infrastructure. In addition, the power supply for the battery is taken by the pressure produced while walking. All of these uses would increase access to power and raise standard of living.

articleTitle: Maximizing Signal Range and Endurance in Military Wristband Antenna System
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: In modern military operations, secure and reliable communication is essential for mission success, ensuring accurate information exchange and potentially saving lives. Soldiers often face harsh conditions such as moisture, sweat, and intense physical activity, requiring communication systems that are both durable and efficient. Additionally, these systems must support location tracking and recognition for enhanced situational awareness. To address these requirements, a high-performance wristband antenna has been developed, operating at a 50 GHz frequency with a broad bandwidth of 10 dB. Unlike conventional communication devices, this wristband antenna is compact, wearable, and designed to withstand environmental challenges, ensuring long-term durability without compromising performance. The antenna is engineered to achieve peak gain at 0 degrees, with a directivity of 5.4365 dB and a VSWR of 1.4363. Constructed using silicon as the primary material and an FR4 substrate for structural support, it provides a balance of robustness and efficiency. A prototype has been developed,in ANSYS HFSS software and simulated tests have confirmed its performance in both planar and conformal configurations, demonstrating its effectiveness across various operational environments.

articleTitle: Evaluating Lithium-Ion and Nickel-Metal Hydride Batteries in EVs: A Data-Driven Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)

authors.preferredName: V T Ram Pavan Kumar M

abstract: The performance and longevity of Electric Vehicle (EV) batteries are critical for advancing sustainable transportation. This study presents a data-driven machine learning approach to systematically compare Lithium-Ion and Nickel-Metal Hydride batteries using real-world data from the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Battery Data Hub. Unlike previous research, which primarily focuses on isolated performance metrics, our study integrates multiple factors such as energy density, charge rate, cycle life, and thermal stability. We employ advanced machine learning models— LSTM, XGBoost, and Random Forest—to predict battery state-of-charge and state-of-health with high accuracy, achieving R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> values above 0.97 in SOC estimation using LSTM. Our findings confirm that Li-ion batteries outperform NiMH in key performance areas, exhibiting higher energy density, slower degradation rates, and better thermal stability. The results offer crucial insights for battery selection in EV applications and highlight the potential of ML-driven approaches in battery management systems (BMS) to enhance real-time monitoring and predictive maintenance. By optimizing battery performance and reducing premature failures, this study contributes to the sustainable adoption of EV technology.

articleTitle: Optimization of Hybrid Tunable Leaf-Shaped Optical Nano Antenna
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: The growing demand for high-performance nano-antennas in communication systems and sensing technologies has highlighted the need for efficient designs in the terahertz (THz) frequency range. This work focuses on the optimization of a hybrid tunable optical nano-antenna, featuring a Peepal leaf-shaped microstrip patch designed for THz applications. The unique leaf shape enhances resonance and electromagnetic field confinement, improving the antenna’s directivity and radiation efficiency. The key challenge addressed is achieving a balance between high directivity and tunability while minimizing losses. By incorporating hybrid plasmonic waveguide technology, the antenna achieves tunability across a wide frequency range, offering flexibility for various applications. Through simulation and analysis, the work evaluates the impact of varying geometrical parameters such as leaf length, width, and curvature on the antenna’s performance. The optimized design delivers improved directivity and radiation patterns, making it suitable for THz communication systems and optical sensing applications. The results demonstrate significant advancements in tunable nano-antenna design.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Driven Design of Smart Materials with Adaptive Properties for Advanced Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: Machine Learning (ML) is revolutionizing the design of smart materials by allowing fast discovery and optimization of adaptive materials, supplanting slow, conventional trial-and-error processes. ML methods such as deep learning and reinforcement learning make data-driven predictions of material properties, speeding innovation in shape memory alloys, self-healing polymers, piezoelectric materials, and metamaterials. Case studies highlight how machine learning (ML) is being used to build innovations in the fields of energy harvesting, medicinal implants, aerospace, and AR/VR. There are still challenges with experimental verification, interpretability of models, and the lack of data. These have to be addressed through interdisciplinary collaboration and merging of AI-based methods with physics-based models. Potential to revolutionize fields such as electronics, healthcare, and aerospace into next-generation materials with improved performance and efficiency, the future of machine learning (ML)-based smart materials is highly promising

articleTitle: Bluetooth-based Voice-Activated Smart Home System using Arduino Uno for Cost-Effective Automation
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: The research introduces a cost-efficient voice-controlled home automation system based on products such as Arduino Uno and Bluetooth (HC-06) module. The main purpose of the system focuses on making home appliances accessible through voice commands for people who are elderly or physically challenged. The application proceeds by capturing audio from Android which converts voice to text command transmissions through Bluetooth to the Arduino for processing and appliance control procedures. The experimental tests proved the device’s capability to operate various devices reliably after receiving pre-defined instructions such as “ON”, “RED” and “OFF”. The research has confirmed that the operating system enables uninterrupted control along with restrained hardware necessities in confined systems. The main value of this work depends on its basic design requirements together with affordable cost and immediate functionality that operates independently of internet access or complex systems which support applications in regions with few resources. The presented solution fills the gap between hand-operated control systems and complete smart home integration by using voice detection and Bluetooth connections.

articleTitle: Development of an IoT-Enabled Real-Time Monitoring and Alert System Model for Hydroponic Farming
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: India is one of the leading countries in the agriculture sector. Traditional farming is not fulfilling the current population's needs, and soil salinity is increasing daily due to using fertilizers and pesticides. An alternative to that can be smart farming. New farming techniques like vertical farming technology like hydroponics can overcome these challenges. Hydroponics is an effective technique that can enlarge plants without soil. The proposed integrated system manages and monitors hydroponics using Internet of Things (IoT). The challenges of managing the resources will be handled by the growing IoT trend. The current system constantly monitors and measures PH, temperature, relative humidity, light intensity, water level and TDS, striving to create the ideal circumstances for plants to flourish. Information from the sensors is saved, managed, applied, and shared through the Internet service provider (ISP) and Application Programming Interface (API) to the cloud for real-time monitoring and alert handling in hydroponics according to sensor data. The IoT technology allows the device to deliver controlled water TDS, PH, temperature, nutritional solution intake, humidity, water level and light intensity. The effective sensory communication model reduces lots of human efforts by automating the system.

articleTitle: Prediction of Consumption of Energy in an Area
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: Energy consumption optimization and energy wastage minimization and encouragement of sustainable development. These will mostly depend on the energy prediction patterns. In this research, advanced forms of learning are used to help forecast energy usage area. Due to issues such as high dimensional feature space non-stationary pattern and seasonal variation, the study used the regression analysis, the neural network and the support vector regression. This work also has additional contributions through deep learning integration for increasing accuracy and feature engineering for better prediction capability. Besides, the approach proves useful in strategy formulation based on energy distribution as well as energy planning. These results will gives the Real-Time Energy Consumption Prediction Trends.

articleTitle: Sensing of Surface Texture using Smart Glove for Post Stroke Rehabilitation
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: Post-stroke patients need to be rehabilitated in order to gain partly or fully some of the motor facilities that seem to have ceased to function effectively. According to the research, post-stroke deficits in the human ability to palpate and comprehend surface features is the major difficulty a stroke survivor may experience; often they cause harm or accidentally destroy objects due to an incorrect manner of holding them. This research offers a new strategy with the aid of wearable haptic interface in the form of a smart glove that employs an ESP32 microcontroller and force sensors to identify surface texture. Using pattern recognition, we can effectively distinguish between a rough and a smooth surface to adapt to the pressure required to hold any object. This innovation apart from improving safety also gives the patient feedback in the process of rehabilitation. The use of machine learning in particular proves to be more preferable when it comes to texture recognition preventing shortcomings observed in other senor-based approaches.

articleTitle: Automated Railway Track Crack Detection and Emergency Halt System
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: Trains, in the modern world, have an increasing number of passengers besides having heavier axle loads because of increased speeds. All these combinations have put a great deal of strain on aging infrastructure, consequently increasing requirements for efficient inspection and maintenance of rail assets. But, on the other hand, nowadays, it is getting riskier too. There were a lot of accidents because of a lack of mutual communication among the network systems, such as signals at the wrong position, worse weather condition, immediate route change, etc. Because of these reasons, a driver would not get the right information on time, then before so he may get into hazardous situations. We plan to use this system with the help of ultrasonic sensors, a relay, an Arduino Nano, and a metal detector to avert train accidents, so that it can provide a means of allowing the two trains to communicate with each other to avoid accidents.

articleTitle: Power Quality Optimization using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: Power quality optimization is increasingly important in modern electrical systems due to the rising complexity of power grids and the integration of renewable energy sources. This paper introduces a novel approach to power quality management using Deep Learning techniques, specifically Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), to predict and mitigate power disturbances such as harmonics, voltage sags, and frequency variations in real time. By incorporating Active Power Filters (APFs) and Proportional-Integral (PI) controllers, the system dynamically adjusts voltage levels and reactive power compensation to optimize power quality. Real-time data collection from smart sensors enables the DNN to analyze and predict potential issues before they impact the system, ensuring a proactive approach to power management.

articleTitle: Next-Gen Power Board PCB Design for EV Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: This initiative seeks to develop an advanced power conversion system designed specifically for onboard chargers in electric vehicles (EVs). The system proficiently trans- forms grid-supplied alternating current (AC) into a consistent direct current (DC) voltage, essential for charging the EV battery efficiently. The architecture comprises a rectifier, a DC-DC converter, and an intelligent control unit that meticulously regulates both voltage and current, thereby assuring safe and effective charging processes. It functions in both constant voltage (CV) and constant current (CC) operational modes, with an intricate power management scheme facilitated by a proportional-integral (PI) controller and pulse generation circuits. The printed circuit board (PCB) design files will encompass the necessary schematic diagrams and routing information required for the production of this next-generation Power Board.

articleTitle: n-Bit ALU using CMOS Forced Transistor Stacking
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: This paper proposes the design of an n-bit ALU using CMOS Forced Transistor Stacking, emphasising its performance based on power consumption and delay compared to CMOS circuits. While CMOS designs are widely used, they suffer from high power consumption and latency. In comparison, Forced Transistor Stacking boosts the effective resistance under idle conditions and reduced leakage power by connecting transistors in series. Each block of the suggested ALU design is made up of forced stack transistor circuits and is intended to carry out fundamental arithmetic and logical operations. Using Cadence Virtuoso for simulation and evaluation, this paper highlights the advantages of stacked transistors based on parameters like delay, power consumed and transistor count. The potential of forced transistor stacking as a practical technique for upcoming low-power VLSI designs is highlighted in the study. It exhibits advantages in reduced power leakage, increased power efficiency, scalability for dense systems and thermal benefits. These features make this technique an attractive solution for modern, low-performance, and high-performance digital systems.

articleTitle: Effect of Coil Geometry on Power Transfer Efficiency in Resonant Inductive Power Transfer (RIPT) for Electric Vehicle Charging
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: The rapid expansion of the electric vehicle (EV) market necessitates efficient and reliable battery charging solutions. Wireless Power Transfer (WPT) technology offers a promising alternative by eliminating the physical connection between vehicles and charging equipment, addressing limitations of conventional conductive systems while maintaining comparable power ratings and efficiency. This paper investigates the factors influencing the effective transfer distance in WPT systems using coupled magnetic resonance. A detailed analysis of the relationship between coil radius and transfer distance is presented through theoretical modeling, circuit analysis, and magnetic field simulations using ANSYS MAXWELL. Results reveal that coil impedance significantly impacts transfer distance, leading to the development of a novel coil design methodology. Experimental validation demonstrates the proposed method’s accuracy and effectiveness. Furthermore, challenges associated with conventional flat square in achieving longer power transmission distances are highlighted, along with strategies to enhance power transfer efficiency and system reliability.

articleTitle: Real-Time Alzheimer’s Care System using Embedded Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Trends in Material Science and Inventive Materials (ICTMIM)
abstract: This research focuses on the development of OpenCV-enabled assistance system for Alzheimer's patients using embedded technology. The system was designed to enhance user safety and independence through real-time monitoring and alert mechanisms.
